description: VN→ZH missing degree adverb: a bare monosyllabic adjective predicate needs a degree adverb in Mandarin ('我很累', not '我累' as a neutral statement). Vietnamese 'tôi mệt' has no such word, so learners drop 很. Rule zh-bare-adjective-hen inserts 很 for a subject pronoun + a closed monosyllabic adjective at clause end.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk, tightly scoped. Inserts 很 only for a leading subject pronoun + a closed monosyllabic adjective (高累忙饿渴冷热好难贵大小多) at clause end. Any 很/不/太/是 between the pronoun and the adjective blocks the match (those are other rules' domain); the change-of-state '我累了' fails the clause-end lookahead and abstains.

positive.notes: 我累 → 我很累 (insert degree adverb 很).

negative.notes: Negated 不累 — 不 sits between pronoun and adjective, must abstain.
Change-of-state '我累了' ('I've gotten tired') — 累 is followed by 了, not clause end, must abstain.
